hebrewText: נָמ֤וּ רֹעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ אַדִּירֶ֑י/ךָ נָפֹ֧שׁוּ עַמְּ/ךָ֛ עַל הֶ/הָרִ֖ים וְ/אֵ֥ין מְקַבֵּֽץ

tokens.bdb: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, [phrase] shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanation: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanationEn: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively

tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
tokens.kjv: Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838 (אָשֻׁר).

tokens.bdb: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).
excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.
grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.kjv: assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, [idiom] surely, take up.
